name: Header Empty String Shadowing Vulnerability
details: In Elixir, empty string "" is truthy. If config has `http_referer: ""` and `site_url: "http://..."`, `"" || site_url` evaluates to `""`, ignoring site_url.

name: Header Type Guarding
details: Missing type guards on optional headers

name: Explicit Nil Model Edge Case
details: Map.merge(%{model: default_model}, %{model: nil}) results in config.model == nil, which sends null model to OpenRouter API (causes 400 Bad Request).

name: Missing Usage Fallback Map
details: Missing 'usage' key defaults to zeroed token map

name: JSON Null Usage Key Edge Case
details: When API response contains `"usage": null`, `Map.get(body, "usage", default)` returns `nil` instead of default map, populating `metadata.usage` with `nil`.

name: Structured & Unstructured HTTP Error Handling
details: Handles nested %{error => %{message}}, top-level %{error => msg}, and raw status bodies

name: Network Timeout / Transport Error Handling
details: {:error, error} caught and formatted by handle_error/1

name: Tool Execution Dispatcher
details: execute_tool_calls/1 handles list of tool calls

name: Missing Tool Module Handling
details: Catches missing tool module and returns formatted error tuple

name: Tool Execution Exception Safety
details: Tool call execution (handler/run/focus) is not wrapped in try/rescue. If a tool raises an unhandled exception or crashes, OpenRouter.call/3 will crash.
